notes: The Human Capital section refers readers to the 2026 Sustainability Report, but the 10-K itself describes specific activities in more than 150 words, so coverage is sufficient and no second look is triggered. Several items are not scored. Micron Research Labs (about $10 billion planned over a decade) is the company's own R&D and is a planned commitment. The Crucial consumer business exit announced in December 2025 is not relevant to any theme. Trap terms are excluded: the 'foundation' of the New York fab is construction, 'foundation models' is AI, 'collaborative relationships with customers' is a commercial relationship, patent licensing is not creative licensing, and 'diversified portfolio' is not inclusion. Required respectful-workplace training is compliance training. The CEO's past co-founding of SanDisk is not a company activity. The filing does not say which communities the ERGs serve, so their cross-cultural scope is inferred from their being employee networks. Community investments are cited only as a qualitative driver of SG&A growth, with no dollar amount.
